step.cmd: In NWS, on the claim with the old SIN, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC on the claim with the old SIN as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “SIN change — permanent SIN obtained.”
Details: Type “New SIN — [new SIN].” Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .

step.cmd: In NWS, create an external SROC with the new SIN as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Other .
Comments: Type “SIN change.”
Details: Type “New SIN obtained — old SIN is [old SIN].”
Select Save .

step.cmd: In RCM, create an interim ROE with the new SIN for each ROE that affects the current claim and was input with the old SIN as follows:

ul.li:
On the Input screen, complete the fields as follows:
Social Insurance No.: Enter the new SIN.
Serial Number: Leave this field blank.
Serial Number of amended ROE or replaced: Leave this field blank.
Interim ROE Type: Select Regular Interim or Fishing Interim .
Printing Language: Select the language used on the original ROE.
Select Submit .
On the Input Regular ROE or Input Fishing ROE screen, enter the same information as shown on the original ROE with the old SIN.
Additional information: Type “SIN change — old SIN [old SIN and serial number of original ROE].”
Select Submit .

step.cmd: For all the ROEs issued with the old SIN, determine the ROE issue date:

ul.li: If the issue date is after the effective date of the new SIN, go to step 9.
If the issue date is before the effective date of the new SIN, go to step 21.

step.cmd: In RCM, delete each ROE that was incorrectly issued with the old SIN as follows:

ul.li: Select Search/Correct .
Social Insurance No.: Enter the old SIN.
Serial Number: Leave this field blank.
Select Submit .
Select a serial number to open an ROE.
Status: Check the Delete box.
Additional information: Type “SIN change — [new SIN].”
Select Submit .

step.cmd: Fact-find with the employer and do the following:

ul.li: Advise the employer to reissue the ROE with the new SIN.
Inform the employer that the ROE issued with the old SIN has been deleted.

step.cmd: Determine if the employer was reached during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the employer was reached, go to step 12.
If the employer was not reached or did not reply to the Z-02-00-00 letter, go to step 19.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC with the new SIN as follows:

ul.li: Main issue: Select ROE .
Comments: Type “SIN change — [new SIN].”

Details: Type “[Employer’s name] incorrectly issued the record of employment with the old SIN.” If necessary, type “Unable to contact the employer by telephone — a second letter was sent.” Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if the employer states the ROE will be provided:

ul.li: If yes and the employer is faxing the ROE to Service Canada, go to step 14.
If yes and the employer will issue the electronic ROE in a timely manner, go to step 14.
If yes and the employer will provide the client with a paper ROE or true copy of the original paper ROE, go to 14.
If no, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select ROE .
Comments: Type “ROE request.”

Bring forward date: Do one of the following:
If the employer is faxing the ROE, enter today’s date + 2 business days.
If the employer indicated that the electronic ROE will be issued in a timely manner, enter today’s date + 5 business days.
If the employer is sending a paper ROE, enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if the ROE is displayed in RMDS or RCM:

ul.li: If the ROE is not displayed in RMDS or RCM, go to step 16.
If the ROE is displayed in RCM, go to step 21.

step.cmd: Determine if the paper copy, or an uploaded or faxed copy of the ROE has been received:

ul.li: If the ROE was not received and the bring-forward date is not reached, return to step 14.
If an uploaded or faxed copy of a paper ROE was received, go to step 17.
If a copy of the ROE has not been received and the bring-forward date is reached, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In RCM, enter the ROE by referring to Data entry — Paper document . If the ROE that was entered has validation errors, correct the errors by referring to Correct an ROE and go to step 21.
In ACS, create and send the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Opening Sentence to ER to Request or Clarify ROE/RFS (2794): Select Request ROE Opening Sentence - claimant .

Request for a Record of Employment (2797) .
Select Initial Request for ROE .
Select Start-end date of employment / End date of employment (2798) .
Go to step 20.

step.cmd: In ACS, send a registered copy of the Z-02-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Opening Sentence to ER re: Request or Clarify ROE/RFS (2794): Select Request ROE Opening Sentence — claimant .
Request for a Record of Employment (2797): Select Follow up request for ROE .

Previously requested by mail (2799):
Date ROE requested: Type the date the original letter was sent.
End date of period of employment: Type the employment end date.
Date of BF: Enter 10 business days from the date the letter is sent.
Attachment List for Z-02-00-00 (3133): Copy of original letter .
Indicate on letter how letter mailed (2804): Sent by registered mail .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a REM WI with the new SIN as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1.
Reason: Select Missing ROE .
Comments: Type “The employer must issue a new ROE.”
Due date: Enter 10 working days from the date on which a valid ROE was requested.

Details: Type “SIN change. The employer issued an ROE with the old SIN although the new SIN was already valid. An interim ROE was created. The employer must issue a new ROE. If the employer does not comply, refer the file to Integrity.”
Destination — SCC: Select the Service Canada Centre (SCC) as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Next Available User .

step.cmd: In FTS, with the old SIN, determine if there is a registration number for the SIN issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 22.

If no, select the Registration Number(M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Refer to Conversion and Renewal to complete the renewal, and then return to step 23.
After calculating the renewal, move the SIN-related WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “SIN change on renewal.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 1 business day.

step.cmd: When the SIN-related WI moves to your current workload, in FTS, with the old SIN select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the request for a SIN change.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 34 - Social insurance number change .
Remarks Line 1: Type “SIN change to [new SIN].”
Remarks Line 2: Enter the list of all BPCs (dormant and current) with old SIN.
Remarks Line 3: Enter “New initial claim created with new SIN needs to be cancelled”.
Remarks Line 4: Leave this field blank unless needed for BPCs.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a REM WI using the new SIN as follows:

ul.li: Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Review access code after SIN change.”
Due date: Enter 7 working days from the date on which the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction was sent to IPOC.

Details: Type “SIN change. Once the electronic file has been updated with the new SIN, determine if an access code appears in FTS. If no, contact the client, conduct a detailed security check and issue a temporary access code. If yes, complete the REM WI.”
Destination — SCC: Select the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself .
Send to my pending workload: Check the box.

step.cmd: Complete the WI related to the SIN change.
